seo_title: Shelf Check: a 5-day packaging audit — Sharp Story
seo_description: See your pack the way your buyer does. A 5-day audit of your packaging against five competitors on shelf, Amazon, Blinkit and Zepto, with prioritised fixes.
label: Shelf Check
heading: See your pack the way your buyer does.
lead: Most packaging problems are invisible from the inside. In five days, we put your brand next to five competitors, on shelf and on screen, and show you exactly where it loses attention.
includes: A side-by-side audit on shelf, Amazon, Blinkit and Zepto
A review of clarity, hierarchy, variant differentiation and claims
A written diagnosis with prioritised fixes
credit_note: The full fee is credited if you go ahead with a Hero Pack, Launch System or Range Refresh.
